# netcup Provider

Terraform provider for managing netcup infrastructure via the CCP DNS API (DomainWebservice JSON API), CloudDNS API, and SCP REST API (Server Control Panel OpenAPI). Supports CloudDNS and CCP DNS records, DNS zones, virtual servers, reverse DNS (rDNS IPv4/IPv6), network interfaces, firewall policies, snapshots, failover IPs, VLANs, custom images, ISOs, provider-defined functions, and ephemeral tokens under Terraform Plugin Framework protocol version 6.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    netcup = {
      source  = "rixlhq/netcup"
      version = "~> 1.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "netcup" {
  clouddns_api_key = var.netcup_clouddns_api_key

  api_key         = var.netcup_api_key
  api_password    = var.netcup_api_password
  customer_number = var.netcup_customer_number

  scp_access_token  = var.netcup_scp_access_token
  scp_refresh_token = var.netcup_scp_refresh_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Netcup API key generated in the Customer Control Panel for the CCP/DNS API. Can be set via the `NETCUP_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `api_password` (String, Sensitive) Netcup API password generated in the Customer Control Panel for the CCP/DNS API. Can be set via the `NETCUP_API_PASSWORD` environment variable.
- `clouddns_api_key` (String, Sensitive) CloudDNS bearer API key from CCP Master Data > API > API Keys. Can be set via `NETCUP_CLOUDDNS_API_KEY`. Separate from legacy CCP and SCP credentials.
- `clouddns_base_url` (String) Override the CloudDNS API base URL (default https://api.netcup.com). Can be set via `NETCUP_CLOUDDNS_BASE_URL`.
- `customer_number` (String) Netcup customer number for the CCP/DNS API. Can be set via the `NETCUP_CUSTOMER_NUMBER` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) Override the netcup CCP JSON API endpoint. Can be set via the `NETCUP_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `scp_access_token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer access token for the netcup SCP REST API. Can be set via the `NETCUP_SCP_ACCESS_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `scp_base_url` (String) Override the netcup SCP REST API base URL. Can be set via the `NETCUP_SCP_BASE_URL` environment variable.
- `scp_refresh_token` (String, Sensitive) Offline refresh token for the netcup SCP REST API. Can be set via the `NETCUP_SCP_REFRESH_TOKEN` environment variable.
